title: The first years
lede: Residents describe life on the unfinished estate in 1972.
body: The first residents moved into Speed House in 1969. Three years later, BBC Nationwide asked people what it was like to live here.

title: A home in colour
body: Design journalist Tom Morris shows us his home in this film by The Modern House and Farrow & Ball.

title: A month in the estate
lede: Bêka and Lemoine meet the people who live and work here.
body: Ila Bêka and Louise Lemoine spent a month filming at the Barbican for their documentary Barbicania. This is the trailer.
